close_reason: Refactored sites 1 and 3 from match-on-Option to map_or/map_or_else. Site 2 left as-is per the issue's caveat (the explicit None arm is the readability anchor and the rewrite would be a wash). Builds clean.
description:
Pass 2 idiom finding under epic PKIX-qwzx.

Clippy nursery `option_if_let_else` flags three patterns in `pkix-path/src/lib.rs`
where a long `match Some(x) / None` block could be expressed via
`Option::map_or`/`Option::map_or_else`:

1. **`pkix-path/src/lib.rs:1248-1258`** — `try_find_cert_ext`:
   ```rust
   match cert.tbs_certificate.extensions.as_deref().unwrap_or(&[])
       .iter().find(|e| e.extn_id == oid) {
       None => Ok(None),
       Some(e) => T::from_der(e.extn_value.as_bytes()).map(Some),
   }
   ```
   Could be `.map_or_else(|| Ok(None), |e| T::from_der(e.extn_value.as_bytes()).map(Some))`.

2. **`pkix-path/src/lib.rs:2018-2028`** — initial NC seeding from anchor:
   ```rust
   let (mut nc_permitted, mut nc_excluded) = match &anchor.name_constraints {
       None => (None, GeneralSubtrees::default()),
       Some(nc) => (nc.permitted_subtrees.clone(), nc.excluded_subtrees.clone().unwrap_or_default()),
   };
   ```

3. **`pkix-path/src/lib.rs:2040-2049`** — initial `nc_constrained_types` mask:
   ```rust
   let mut nc_constrained_types: NcTypeMask = match &nc_permitted {
       None => NcTypeMask::EMPTY,
       Some(permitted) => { let mut bits = NcTypeMask::EMPTY; for st in permitted { ... } bits }
   };
   ```

Caveat: site 2 has a comment explaining the `clone()` is intentional, and the
`map_or_else` rewrite reduces readability for the explicit `None` arm. Sites
1 and 3 are clear wins; site 2 is closer to a wash.

Fix: rewrite sites 1 and 3 using `map_or` / `map_or_else`. Leave site 2 if the
maintainer prefers the explicit `match` for the readability anchor on the
`None` branch.

These are clippy nursery (default-allow) so this is purely a stylistic
nudge; not blocking.
title: (IDIOM) P4: clippy nursery option_if_let_else flags 3 sites in pkix-path that could use Option::map_or/map_or_else
